gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Expressive and loose, Revalia strides along with widely separated letters and a g whose lower curve stays open. Noto Sans Cuneiform has swollen, glass-bead lowercase, while Revalia earns its keep in large, brief headings.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Revalia is loud, loose and wide-striding up top. Noto Sans Deseret settles underneath with open apertures and squat ascenders, giving the heading room to shout while the text stays approachable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Revalia brings a bold, expressive swagger, its g curling open at the bottom and letters strolling apart. And Noto Sans Elbasan would carry a paragraph without snagging, its terminals open and its lowercase generous.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Widely separated letters give Revalia its relaxed stride, bold and expressive from the first word. But the real draw is the gap in temperament: Noto Sans Elymaic stays open and quiet where Revalia struts.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic hangs its c terminals far from the bowl, sturdy and modern. Noto Sans Ethiopic is built for steady reading; Revalia is built to be noticed, with its open-curled g.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian reads cleanly, with open curves throughout and short ascender stems, sitting quietly beneath Revalia's bold, expressive heading. The sharpest quality here is range: loud heading, modest text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Revalia swaggers with a bold, expressive hand, its g open at the bottom and its letters spaced well apart. Noto Sans Glagolitic offers round, approachable letters, leaving Revalia to earn its keep in large, brief lines.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Revalia is bold and loose, its letters spread in a relaxed stride. Noto Sans Grantha runs on in pen-nib bowls pressed flat that never close up, so a full page of it glides without snagging.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gond: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi lays down crayon-thick strokes and trims its terminals back to leave a wide gap. Revalia brings the swagger, its g open, while the body stays readable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads crisply, its terminals pointing outward like tongs and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height, under Revalia's bold heading. Paragraphs of it would move along smoothly.
